segments.name: Consumer finance
segments.description: Provides consumer loans and complementary services such as insurance, tax preparation and automobile club through a branch network.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment: the consumer finance segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay interest and fees on short- to medium-term consumer loans, plus premiums and fees for related insurance, tax preparation and automobile club services.
revenueModel.evidence: During fiscal 2026, 2025, and 2024, the Company originated loans generally ranging up to $ 5,300 with terms of 60 months or fewer.
